title: Geometry on Arc Spaces of Algebraic Varieties
container-title: European Congress of Mathematics, Vol. I (Barcelona, 2000)
note: Foundational survey of arc spaces $L(X) = \varprojlim L_n(X)$ and motivic integration. Provides the change-of-variables formula for blow-ups and the motivic measure on cylindrical subsets of $L(X)$.
